evidence_slice: Islington Council adopted its new Local Plan on 28 September 2023. The adopted Site Allocations identify OIS15 as Harvist Estate Car Park, N7 7NJ. The public Site Allocations Feature Layer (ID 41) is esriGeometryPolygon, supports JSON/geoJSON/PBF, uses 'sitereference' and 'sitename' fields, and was last edited on 13 January 2025.
